title: Compact per-cell source facts carried from planning delete the XLSX commit's second whole-sheet layout scan
code_state: crates/litchi-xlsx only; no public API, error type, limit or output byte changed; no new unsafe and no new dependency
reason_codes: change 0550 measured the commit's layout scan at 53.24-54.94% of commit instructions and named its removal the next task; this removes it and the symbol is absent from the after profile

the design is change 0551's, implemented as frozen: compact per-cell source offsets with changed-cell tag materialization, a builder that declines rather than errors, and a differential oracle proving the facts reproduce the layout the scan would have built
0550's admission condition is met: planning plus commit instructions fall 33.6-41.4%, so work is removed rather than shifted; publication is untouched

the two gates that rejected changes 0552 and 0553 are cleared: valid no-op planning is unaffected because an empty plan returns before the fact route is consulted, and dense-sparse process peak RSS rises 4.23% at the median inside that leg's own 6.49% run-to-run spread, against 0552's +6.97% and 0553's +5.16%

value identity is proved two ways: 32 of 32 (case, shape) published-package sha256 pairs are identical, and an in-crate oracle compares the fact-derived and scan-derived rewrites byte for byte and error for error

accepted_evidence.counts: callgrind isolation pairs, N=1 and N=11, differenced and divided by 10, per leg for one_edit_save on medium/dense-sparse/noncompact and one_percent_edit_save on medium/dense-sparse; whole-sample totals plus per-symbol inclusive Ir for from_source_selected, scan_with_limit and rewrite_value_only_with_provenance
accepted_evidence.allocations: litchi-perf-baseline-alloc with the change-0538 phase regions (plan, staging, commit_core, commit, publication), five samples per leg, maximum per region
accepted_evidence.peak_rss: /usr/bin/time -f %M, fifteen runs per leg on dense-sparse one_edit_save, with the before leg's own run-to-run spread reported beside the delta
accepted_evidence.timing: tools/perf-baseline, --warmup 5 --samples 30, order A1 B1 B2 A2 on CPU 15, followed by four before-only runs F1..F4 for the A/A floor in the same window, over five source-backed cell-value cases and three shapes
accepted_evidence.value_identity: output_sha256 for 32 (case, shape) pairs across eight source-backed edit cases and four shapes including vendor-extension
accepted_evidence.differential_oracle: crates/litchi-xlsx/src/cell_values/facts_oracle_tests.rs: eleven admitted synthetic shapes, sixteen declined shapes, a dense grid, and every worksheet part of every .xlsx under test-data/; each cell compared through both routes with test-only route counters proving which route ran

accepted_costs.planning_grows: the fact builder costs 15.0-17.7% of planning instructions and 3.90-6.09% of planning allocated bytes; it is paid on every source-backed planning of an admitted worksheet, including plans that never commit
accepted_costs.instruction_counts: instructions rank work, not latency; callgrind counts rep movsb per byte and runs SHA-256 in software; one deterministic run per leg
accepted_costs.whole_sample_totals: the isolation pair's per-sample scope is the harness iteration, which includes the per-sample output verification the timed scope excludes, so the whole-sample Ir delta understates the delta over the timed interval
accepted_costs.peak_rss_noise: process peak RSS is a process-lifetime high-water mark, not an operation-local peak, and the before leg's own spread exceeds the measured delta
accepted_costs.narrowing: a worksheet carrying a <f> element, an ampersand inside a start tag, a cell or row without an explicit r, or any direct worksheet child outside dimension/sheetViews/sheetFormatPr/cols/sheetData keeps the complete scan

known_gaps.real_producer_reach: of 391 real worksheet parts under test-data/, 207 are admitted to the shared traversal but exactly one is accepted by the value-only planning validator, and that one publishes facts; change 0602 established the editor admits none of the 95 real .xlsx fixtures, and this change neither widens nor narrows that surface
known_gaps.second_commit: only the first commit of a snapshot chain uses the facts; a snapshot derived from a rewrite drops them and pays the scan
known_gaps.formulas: worksheets carrying <f> are declined by design, not by measurement
known_gaps.oracle_stride: the corpus sweep visits every cell of worksheets with at most 96 cells and a fixed stride through larger ones unless LITCHI_0622_FULL_ORACLE=1 is set

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, cold-cache, physical-I/O, range-source, concurrency-scaling, real-producer or cross-platform result
